rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for undomesticated animals living in the wild.

example.english: There is lots of wildlife over there, so don't go too close.
example.traditional: 嗰度有好多野生動物，唔好行咁埋。
example.jyutping: go2 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 saang1 dung6 mat6 m4 hou2 haang4 gam3 maai4

rows.note: Use this broader term when referring to all kinds of undomesticated living organisms, not just animals.

example.traditional: 保護野生生物係大家嘅責任。
example.jyutping: bou2 wu6 je5 saang1 sang1 mat6 hai6 daai6 gaa1 ge3 zaak3 jam6
